Elon Musk's tunneling enterprise, The Boring Company, reported its Series D funding round of $3B, led by the United Arab Emirates and affiliated investment entities. The financing now values The Boring Company at $23B, according to a statement on Thursday.

Building upon significant existing success collaborating with the UAE on Dubai Loop, this strategic investment will accelerate the partnership to deploy mass quantities of underground infrastructure across the United Arab Emirates, including 150+ kilometers of tunnel. This landmark agreement is in addition to the Dubai Loop project previously awarded.

Other key investors in the round include Human Capital, Vy Capital, Valor Equity Partners, Sequoia Capital, A16Z, Temasek, Shamal Holding, and Baron Capital, in addition to other valued existing and new investors.

title: Musk's Boring Co. valued at $23B after $3B funding
